description:
Cast Sakashima's Student by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Sakashima's Student into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Sakashima's Student dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Sakashima's Student that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Sakashima's Student token instead.
